title: Knock
description: The only admissible message at the front door. See CONTRACT.md Art. 3.

from.description: GitHub login of the caller, or an agent name.

kind.description: What sort of caller this is.

on_behalf_of.description: Required when kind is agent-for-human: the principal's GitHub login. An unnamed principal means no authority (Art. 4).

intent.description: Must be a member of the admissible set in CONTRACT.md Art. 5. That set is currently EMPTY and under negotiation, so every intent is presently inadmissible by design.

payload.description: Intent-specific body. Capped at 64 KiB (Art. 6). Shape per intent is part of the Art. 5 negotiation.

channel.description: Which channel this knock arrived on (Art. 2). A repository_dispatch knock must also supply reply_to.

reply_to.description: The canonical GitHub issue where a reply is recorded (Art. 7). Required when channel is repository_dispatch. Email and off-repo interfaces may notify or relay but are never the canonical record.

nonce.description: Caller-generated unique id. Lets a refused knock be referenced without resending it (Art. 8).
